decisions.statement: The tasks block and the character priority block go into the same file.
The indent is read once for both blocks.
A task is keyed by its page id.
A task has the game's character id rather than the character page's id.
A task row with no page id is left out.
A task already marked done is left out.
The key saying a task is done is read from the page type exported.
No task at all leaves the saved-variables content unchanged.
Only a task marked as awaiting sync is marked back once that task is exported.
The config file is written only where a path is given and the run is for real.
An override row the completion package will not read is left out.
An override is grouped under the game's character id.
An override whose character has no game id is left out.
Everything reaching the network or a file may be handed in by the caller.
Nothing here decides a character's priority.
Nothing here reads or writes a file of its own.

definition: the account's tasks written into the characters saved-variables file and into the addon's config
